description_text: A warm, spiced start to your morning.

Oil pulling is a centuries-old Ayurvedic ritual: swish a spoonful of oil before you brush, and keep the first quiet minutes of the day for yourself. Our Cinnamon Pulling Oil pairs sesame and coconut oils with turmeric, clove and cinnamon for a sweet, warming taste that leaves your mouth feeling clean and your breath fresh.
Before brushing, take about 1 teaspoon (5 ml) into your mouth.
Swish gently for 5 to 20 minutes. Start short and build up.
Spit into the trash, not the sink, so the oil doesn't clog your drain.
Rinse with warm water, then brush as usual.
Naturally sweet, warming cinnamon and clove flavor
Leaves your mouth feeling fresh and clean
Made with certified organic sesame oil, coconut oil and turmeric
Handcrafted in small batches, in a dark glass bottle that protects the oil
Sesame oil*, coconut oil*, turmeric*, barberry*, bhringaraj*, amalaki*, clove*, cinnamon, and essential oils of cassia* and clove*.
4 fl oz or 8 fl oz, in a dark glass bottle.
For oral rinsing only. Do not swallow. Contains sesame and coconut. If irritation occurs, discontinue use.
raw_description_html:
A warm, spiced start to your morning.

Oil pulling is a centuries-old Ayurvedic ritual: swish a spoonful of oil before you brush, and keep the first quiet minutes of the day for yourself. Our Cinnamon Pulling Oil pairs sesame and coconut oils with turmeric, clove and cinnamon for a sweet, warming taste that leaves your mouth feeling clean and your breath fresh.

Your morning ritual

  1. Before brushing, take about 1 teaspoon (5 ml) into your mouth.
  2. Swish gently for 5 to 20 minutes. Start short and build up.
  3. Spit into the trash, not the sink, so the oil doesn't clog your drain.
  4. Rinse with warm water, then brush as usual.

Why you'll love it

  • Naturally sweet, warming cinnamon and clove flavor
  • Leaves your mouth feeling fresh and clean
  • Made with certified organic sesame oil, coconut oil and turmeric
  • Handcrafted in small batches, in a dark glass bottle that protects the oil

Ingredients

Sesame oil*, coconut oil*, turmeric*, barberry*, bhringaraj*, amalaki*, clove*, cinnamon, and essential oils of cassia* and clove*.
*Certified organic

Size

4 fl oz or 8 fl oz, in a dark glass bottle.

For oral rinsing only. Do not swallow. Contains sesame and coconut. If irritation occurs, discontinue use.
